title: Sing When You're Winning — Matched Prevalence Protocol for Sports Outcome-Receipt Composites
motivation: Direct official sports-memorabilia counterexamples show that same-person multiplicity plus one competition context plus an outcome-bearing token is not unique to the Robbie Williams artwork. The next question is prevalence within a genre-matched source frame rather than existence.
primary_question: How often does the frozen SOURCE_PHYSICAL_SUBJECT -> ONE_WORLD -> RECEIPT_OUTCOME_BEARING chain occur among officially licensed single-athlete championship/MVP commemorative composites, compared with broader same-athlete composites without one-event outcome structure?
anti_rescue_rules: Do not add simultaneity as a primary WORLD requirement after Mahomes/LeBron counterexamples.
Do not require exactly one trophy or exactly one outcome token in the primary endpoint after Curry/Jokic/LeBron controls.
Do not exclude licensed sports memorabilia because it is commercial or commemorative; that is the relevant matched genre.
Do not remove a control because it produces a FULL_CHAIN hit.
Do not convert product-title words such as collage into SOURCE multiplicity without image-level or textual provenance.
Do not infer one-event WORLD from a season/career montage unless the source explicitly binds the visible representations to one identified competition/event.

preferred_domains: MLB Authentication / Baseball Hall of Fame store
official licensed memorabilia manufacturers when league-store page is unavailable
eligible_item: single named athlete is the primary subject
final item is a static collage/composite containing at least two photographic or image representations OR source count is independently verified
officially licensed or authoritative institutional provenance
outcome/status context can be identified from title, description or artifact provenance
exclude: fan art as the sole provenance source
team-only composites with no single-athlete same-source question
duplicate SKU mirrors of the same visual design

target_sample.reason: This balance directly estimates the genre confound while preserving WORLD-negative and RECEIPT-negative controls.

blind_scoring_plan.scorer_view: image only where legally and technically retrievable; product identity, athlete name, event title and source URL hidden during scoring

primary: Robbie target classification compared with matched-genre prevalence
secondary: event-bound versus merely symbolic outcome receipt
analysis.cluster_unit: visual design / athlete-event campaign, not storefront mirror URL
analysis.claim_rule: No population prevalence claim until the source frame is enumerated or sampled by a declared reproducible rule.

decision_logic.if_full_chain_common_in_single_event_mvp: Downgrade the Robbie pattern to a genre-typical victory-composite structure.
decision_logic.if_full_chain_rare_even_inside_single_ev: Proceed to independent blind replication before any rarity claim.
decision_logic.if_exactly_five_common: Numerical five has no anomaly value.
decision_logic.if_exactly_five_rare_but_full_chain_comm: Treat count five as decorative/cardinality detail, not evidence for JANUS-specific mechanism.

claim_ceiling: This protocol measures visual-structural prevalence. It cannot establish causality, artist intent, retrocausality, supernatural signaling, or a JANUS-specific mechanism.
